Sheets

Adding, switching sheets

  • adds a sheet, named “Sheet2”, “Sheet3”…
  • A click on a tab displays it; lists the sheets, hidden ones included, and displays the one chosen.

The menu of a tab

Right-click on the tab, or its arrow:

CommandEffect
Deleteafter confirmation; the last visible sheet cannot be deleted
Copyduplicates the sheet
Renameor double click on the name; without [ ] : ? * / ' "
Change colorcolor of the tab
Hidethe sheet is still read by formulas; shows it again
Move left, Move rightchanges the order; the tab can also be dragged

Reading another sheet

The name of the sheet, an exclamation mark, the address. The name goes between apostrophes if it contains a space or a sign.

=Sheet2!B2*2
='Marks 2'!B2
=SUM('Marks 2'!B2:B6)

The reference is typed: switching tabs while entering a formula abandons the entry.

For a range to be read from all sheets by a name, name it with the Workbook scope.
